Compliance.compliance_or_na_reason: The predicate covers parser success before unwrap, non-panicking/aligned table access, valid Load data, file<=memory size and exact bounded address arithmetic/allocation. It does not require disjoint or ordered segments. These are justified non-panicking and valid-ELF constraints, not an invented success obligation for a fallible API (to_flat_binary returns Vec and unwraps). The caller make_bzimage is plain unverified Rust; no claim it proves these premises.

The exact sequence model exposes ordered load processing, extension zeroing, file-byte overwrites and preserved overlapping memory tails, including empty/non-Load inputs. Iterator dependency exports remaining, produces and decrease under readable-table conditions. Plain Rust make_bzimage has no formal filesystem contract; assert_elf64_reloc_supported is a panic-based validation helper and legacy32_rust_target_json is a pure include_str reader. No verified filesystem result is claimed.
